patch trial side effects, all small: new conflict maratha-empire / mughal-empire 57 cell-years in 1687 (Maratha wins, Bijapur's shape touches the Kolhapur side), qing-dynasty / tibet 9 cell-years in 3 years (Tibet wins, R2), qing-dynasty / sip-song-chau-tai +2 cell-years. A trial without my patch shows 1382 cells changing owner at p1690 against the published draft; with it 2352; the difference is exactly 970 cells, nobody to mughal-empire.

the qing-dynasty_1680 keyframe snap still adds about 630 cells (Hubei and south Shaanxi strips outside the admin-1 provinces, plus Chongqing's neighbours) as a keyframe act, not as a ledger event; I did not add an event for it. The page names no date for the Hubei strip: it is placed in 1680 only because wu-sangui-s-zhou_1680 holds Yunnan alone (confidence 2, stated in the entry).

first attempt at the Qing 1680 correction gave Taiwan to the Qing (Cliopatria's Southern Ming 1677 row includes Taiwan and the snap took 101 cells from kingdom-of-tungning); the final entry cuts Taiwan and Yunnan out, checked on the stage render.
